title: Handle an inheritance with care
tagline: Take your time; the money and the paperwork are looked after, step by step.
trigger: A large payment from a notary's estate account.

steps.title: Park the money safely first
steps.description: Move the inheritance to a savings account while you decide. No rush.
steps.why: It landed on your current account; nothing has to be decided now.

win.customer: Earning interest while you take your time

steps.title: The paperwork in one place
steps.description: The notary's documents, the declaration of succession and receipts in your digital vault.
steps.why: Stored at KBC; you decide who sees what.
steps.result: Documents from the notary filed in your digital vault.

steps.title: A plan with an adviser
steps.description: Inheritance and estate planning with a KBC specialist: what to keep, invest or pass on.
steps.why: A conversation, not a sales pitch. Bring your questions.
steps.result: Appointment booked with an estate-planning specialist.

steps.title: Put part of it to work
steps.description: Managed investing in line with your profile, only for money you will not need in the coming years.
steps.why: Investing involves risk; you choose the amount and the profile.
steps.result: Investment proposal ready for your review.
